subject: Aurion Retail - Identity provisioning & SSO deployment checklist
summary: Response to Aurion Retail's RFP section on SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC/admin controls and deployment runbook. Includes SCIM attribute mapping workbook and a deployment playbook; internal pricing/legal coordination occurred before DocuSign request.
messages:
From: Samantha Li <s.liang@aurionretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@aurionretail.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:58 -0700
Subject: Aurion RFP - IDAM follow-ups (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Jordan,

Thanks for the RFP packet — a few clarifying items from our identity team before we move this to procurement:

1) SCIM: we provided a sample user object in the RFP. Can you confirm the maximum attribute set Redwood will sync (email, displayName, title, manager, department, customAttribX)? Do you support incremental sync and filtered group sync?
2) SSO: We use SAML currently for most apps but are piloting OIDC for new services. Will Redwood accept both SAML metadata and OIDC discovery endpoints simultaneously? How do you handle primary identifier (email vs. alternate_id) for account linking?
3) RBAC/admin controls: we need a delegated admin model so Ops can create tenant-scoped admins but not grant global privileges. Do you provide a built-in admin role matrix export for audit?

Also attaching our IDAM appendix for reference (attachment: Aurion_RFP_IDAM_v1.pdf). Can we get a short deployment checklist and the SCIM mapping workbook?

- Samantha Li
Head of Identity, Aurion Retail
Samantha.Li@aurionretail.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <s.liang@aurionretail.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@aurionretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 13:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurion RFP - IDAM follow-ups (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear questions and the appendix. Short answers up front, followed by proposed attachments and next steps: 

1) SCIM scope: Redwood will sync the standard user attributes you listed plus an extensible custom attribute namespace. We support incremental delta sync via Change Notifications and a filtered group-sync based on group membership or attribute-based filters. See the mapping workbook attached.
2) SSO: We support both SAML and OIDC side-by-side. Account linking defaults to email (case-insensitive), but we can bind to an alternate_id (e.g., employeeID) during initial provisioning if you prefer. We include a reconciliation step to avoid duplicate accounts.
3) RBAC/admins: We offer tenant-scoped admin roles and a separate global admin role. There is an exportable role matrix (CSV) and audit logs for role changes.

Attachments I will send in a follow-up email: redwood_scim_mapping_v2.xlsx (attribute map + example filters), a one-page deployment checklist, and SAML metadata. Would you be available for a 30-min technical call tomorrow to walk the mapping?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

From: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@aurionretail.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:02:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurion RFP - IDAM follow-ups (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Jordan —

Quick additional asks from our SRE/security team: 
- Can you produce SAML metadata XML and an example ACS/EntityID values we can drop into our IDP test tenant?
- For OIDC, please include the discovery endpoint and JWKS URI if available.
- For the deployment checklist, include estimated cutover downtime, SCIM sync schedule (initial vs delta), and rollback steps.

Procurement would like to confirm which artifacts (SOC 2 Type II, penetration test summary) we can expect during contracting.

Thanks,
Carlos
Director, Platform Engineering

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@aurionretail.com>, Samantha Li <s.liang@aurionretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 17:22:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurion RFP - IDAM follow-ups (SSO/SCIM/RBAC)

Carlos / Samantha —

Please find the items requested attached and summarized below. Attachments: redwood_saml_metadata.xml (SAML metadata with ACS/EntityID examples), redwood_scim_mapping_v2.xlsx (attribute mapping + filter samples), redwood_iam_deployment_playbook_aurion_20270916.pdf (deployment checklist + rollback).

Key notes:
- SAML + OIDC: both supported. SAML ACS/EntityID in the metadata are examples you can test against. OIDC discovery: https://api.redwood.ai/.well-known/openid-configuration (JWKS URI included in doc).
- SCIM sync: initial full import (up to 24 hours depending on user volume), then incremental deltas every 5 minutes by default (configurable to 1/5/15 minute intervals). Batch size and rate limiting are tunable; recommended start = 5-minute deltas for your projected user change rate.
- RBAC: we recommend a 3-role model for tenant admins (Viewer / Manager / UserAdmin) + 1 global security admin. The playbook includes examples of least-privilege role bindings and an exportable audit CSV.
- Audit / Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 Type II summary and penetration test executive summary are provided in our secure portal; I can share a pre-auth link or provide them to procurement under an NDA.

Next steps proposed: 1) Tech call to walk the mapping (30 min) — I suggested Fri morning in the calendar invite; 2) Procurement to confirm required artifacts and PO timeline; 3) Legal to review standard SOW & SLA for Dedicated/private deployment (if required).

Attachments: redwood_scim_mapping_v2.xlsx (attachment stub), redwood_iam_deployment_playbook_aurion_20270916.pdf (attachment stub), redwood_saml_metadata.xml (attachment stub).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
